import subprocess, threading, time, serial
from serial.tools import list_ports
GW_SN='40:4C:CA:5D:0A:00'; EMU_SN='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'
def resolve(sn):
    end=time.time()+15
    while time.time()<end:
        m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==sn and p.vid==0x303A]
        if len(m)==1: return m[0].device
        time.sleep(.15)
    raise RuntimeError(f'cannot resolve {sn}')
gw=resolve(GW_SN); emu=resolve(EMU_SN)
print(f'CAPTURE_INITIAL_PORTS=GW:{gw} EMU:{emu}',flush=True)
subprocess.run(['python','-m','esptool','--chip','esp32c6','-p',gw,'--before','default_reset','--after','hard_reset','chip_id'],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
print('GW_RESET_FOR_FRESH_FORMATION',flush=True)
gw=resolve(GW_SN)
logs={'GW':[],'EMU':[]}
stop_event=threading.Event()
def reader(name,port):
    with serial.Serial(port,115200,timeout=.1) as s:
        while not stop_event.is_set():
            b=s.readline()
            if b:
                t=b.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip('\r\n'); logs[name].append(t); print(f'{name}: {t}',flush=True)
tg=threading.Thread(target=reader,args=('GW',gw),daemon=True); tg.start()
time.sleep(7.0)
emu=resolve(EMU_SN)
subprocess.run(['python','-m','esptool','--chip','esp32c6','-p',emu,'--before','default_reset','--after','hard_reset','chip_id'],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
print('EMU_RESET_FOR_STEERING',flush=True)
emu=resolve(EMU_SN)
te=threading.Thread(target=reader,args=('EMU',emu),daemon=True); te.start()
time.sleep(120.0)
stop_event.set(); tg.join(timeout=1); te.join(timeout=1)
g='\n'.join(logs['GW']); e='\n'.join(logs['EMU'])
print('GW_LINES='+str(len(logs['GW']))); print('EMU_LINES='+str(len(logs['EMU'])))
print('EMU_ABORT='+str('abort() was called' in e or 'Guru Meditation' in e))
checks={
 'GW_NETWORK_FORMED':['network formed'],
 'GW_PERMIT_JOIN':['permit join duration=180'],
 'GW_ANNOUNCE':['announce'],
 'GW_IAS':['0x0500','ias'],
 'GW_ZONETYPE':['0x0015','zonetype','zone type'],
 'GW_CONTACT':['contact_open','contact open'],
 'EMU_FACTORY_NEW':['factory_new=1'],
 'EMU_STEERING':['network steering status='],
 'EMU_REPORT':['report request ep=1 cluster=0x0500 attr=0x0002']
}
for label,terms in checks.items():
    text=g if label.startswith('GW_') else e
    print(label+'_HITS='+str(sum(text.lower().count(x.lower()) for x in terms)))
print('=== GW RELEVANT ===')
for line in logs['GW']:
    l=line.lower()
    if any(x in l for x in ['zigbee','network','permit','announce','device','descriptor','0x0500','0x0015','ias','zone','contact','report']): print(line)
print('=== EMU RELEVANT ===')
for line in logs['EMU']:
    l=line.lower()
    if any(x in l for x in ['zigbee','factory_new','steering','join','ias','zone','tick','report','abort']): print(line)
PY
